Name: (CR) Kisaa's Bunny Burrow Farm
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=3]﻿﻿Beneath a little forest west of Pelican Town[b], [/b]there lies [b]a vast burrow[/b]... rich in resources but limited in farming space, how will you cultivate the soil in this underground haven?[/size][/center]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Farm added through AdditionalFarms: [/b]Does NOT replace any Vanilla farms and is selectable from the farm type menu on starting a new save.
[*][b]Alternate farm modes: [/b]Features a [b]Lite Mode [/b]with lighter ambient lighting, and a [b]Surface Mode [/b]that transforms the farm into a surface farm when played without the custom farm cave.
[*][b]Custom starter giftbox items: [/b]Lots of options. Choose before starting a new save...
[*][b]Variable starter gifts: [/b]... and you also get extra stuff (or not!) depending on the farm's mode.
[*][b]Fireflies, fireflies galore: [/b]Interact with certain foliage to spawn fireflies to help light your way.
[*][b]Custom fish/crab pot catch pool: [/b]Fish for mountain and town river fish, and Mines fish depending on the season!
[*][b]Mines forage/diggables, quarry, and respawning boulders: [/b]The quarry soil is bountiful and you can forage or dig up items you would normally find in the Mines.
[*][b]Custom farm cave (toggleable) and starter farmhouse layout[/b]
[*][b]Supports 8-person multiplayer![/b]
[*][b]Plenty of farm customization options![/b]
[/list]
[size=3]Want to adjust these features to your liking? You can do it all in the mod config! Install [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3] for easier in-game customization.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

[b][size=3]Custom Farm Cave[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*]The custom cave is outdoors and contains regular outdoor location functionality: season and weather effects, artifact spots, you can plant trees, the grass is diggable... it's very neat!
[*]Otherwise, it functions just like your regular farm cave (can choose mushroom boxes or fruits).
[*]When [b]Custom Farm Cave is set to [i]true[/i][/b], [b]Backwoods and Bus Stop are only accessible through the farm cave.[/b]
[*]When[b] Custom Farm Cave is set to [/b][b]false, [/b][b]you will not get the additional items in the Starter Gift and Mine forage/fish are disabled.[/b]
[/list][b]
[size=3]Farm Modes[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]The [b]Default[/b] farm mode with [b]Custom Farm Cave set to [i]true[/i][/b] gives the farm dark ambient lighting and you will gain an additional [b]1x Small Glow Ring [/b]+ [b]5x Torches [/b]from the Starter Gift.
[*]When [b]Custom Farm Cave is set to [/b][b][i]true[/i] [/b]and [b]Lite Mode is set to [/b][i]﻿[b]true[/b], [/i]the farm has Secret Woods ambient lighting and you will gain an additional [b]5x Torches [/b]from the Starter Gift.
[*]You can toggle Lite Mode if you want to play with the original farm's design and ambiance but less dark.
[*]When [b]Custom Farm Cave is set to [/b][i][b]false[/b],[/i] the farm uses normal ambient lighting and appears like the farm is on the surface. Like a regular farm. Absolutely no benefits from this farm's special gimmicks (aside from the ore spawn in the quarry). What's fun about that?
[/list]
[b][size=3]Gameplay Elements[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]On Default mode, the farm is pretty dark (especially at night and if you use Earthy recolor, as pictured). [b]You can interact with certain flowering bushes to call fireflies and light up your way...[/b]
[/list][spoiler][img]https://i.ibb.co/Rp8sGyhD/BB-Firefly-Bush.png[/img]﻿
[b]Right clicking on these bushes will spawn fireflies.[/b] They will fly around randomly and despawn after each day, so you will have to re-spawn them.[/spoiler]
[list]
[*]For once, [b]the grass in the farm is not diggable. [/b]Will you choose farming space or spots for Mines ore and forage to spawn?
[*][b]Grass Starters can spread on grass terrain though! [/b]Don't worry about growing grass for animals.
[*][b]You can fish for Mines fish in certain water bodies[/b]. Some are fishable in Spring-Fall, but some are fishable only on Winter.
[*]In the same vein, [b]forage/pickups/diggables you can usually find in the Mines also spawn in the farm[/b]. Again, some only appear on Winter.
[*][b]Most pickups and fish you can obtain in Mines 80+ don't spawn, though.[/b] I can't just make things too easy with this farm.
[*]I tried my best to keep things realistic, but ran into some jank that ruined immersion even further or was just not possible because of how the game is coded, so... pretend there's underground lightning and wind in this farm. The rocks are just [i]really [/i]conductive.
[/list]
[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Starter Gift: [/b]Changes stuff you get from the starter gift box. [b][i]Configure before starting the save![/i][/b]
[*][b]Available options:[/b] Farmer (15x Parsnip Seeds), Miner (10x Cherry Bombs, 1x Furnace), Arborist (10x Tree Fertilizer, 2x Mushroom Log), Adventurer (1x Silver Saber, 1x Life Elixir, 5x Field Snack), Fisher (10x Bait, 10x Coal, 1x Fish Smoker).
[*][b]Custom Farm Cave: [/b]Enables custom farm cave. [b][i]Affects Starter Gift contents. Set to false if using other modded farm caves.[/i][/b]
[*][b]Lite Mode: [/b]Makes the ambient lighting lighter while maintaining the original design of the farm. [b][i]Affects Starter Gift contents. Only takes effect if Custom Farm Cave is set to true.[/i][/b]
[/list][b]
The following settings take effect regardless of the Farm Mode:

[/b][list]
[*][b]Quarry Water Spout: [/b]Toggles the water spout and pond north of the quarry.
[*][b]Southwest Hill Pond: [/b]Toggles the pond on the farm's southwest hill.
[*][b]Southeast Hill Pond: [/b]Toggles the pond on the farm's southeast hill.
[*][b]Southeast Hill Peak Trough: [/b]Toggles the water trough on the farm's tallest southeast hill.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, etc.
[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with the following recolor mods: Vibrant Pastoral, Earthy, Starblue, Wittily.

[u]Partially Incompatible[/u] with [b]Grass Growth. [/b]MMAP added a new property that allows grass growth to be set as a tile property, which Grass Growth bypasses entirely. I use this MMAP property to allow grass starters to spread on grass tiles while keeping grass tiles undiggable. If you use GG, then this MMAP feature will not take effect.

[b][u]Not Compatible[/u] [/b]with mods that replace Maps/FarmCave or FarmCave.tmx (unless [b]Custom Farm Cave[/b] is set to false).
[u][b]Not Compatible[/b][/u] with outdoor recolor mods aside from the ones mentioned above.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url]﻿ [b](MINIMUM v.1.8.2 REQUIRED)[/b].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url]﻿ [b](MINIMUM v.1.3.0 REQUIRED).[/b]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Bunny Burrow Farm" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Some lighting effects may not toggle immediately upon time change and after cutscenes. To correct this, [b]move to a different location before going back to the farm.[/b]
[*]Toggling to and from the custom farm cave layout mid-save will require the use of Reset Terrain Features. To correct this, [b]check the "bushes/trees/grass/stumps" box and click "generate" (or "clear" if switching from the custom farm cave)[/b]. Additionally, If you choose the "Mushroom" farm cave option, be careful of accidentally deleting the mushroom boxes while using RTF.
[*]Currently, the Farmhouse (and possibly Greenhouse) cannot be moved to select areas on the farm. In the meantime, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Anything Anywhere[/url]'s [b]Build Anywhere [/b]setting to be able to place them.﻿
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer.
[*][b]This mod is not made for mobile. Related inquiries will not be responded to and/or deleted.[/b]
[/list]
[size=3]Please [b]prioritize reporting any bugs here on Nexus[/b] by following the procedure outlined in the pinned post.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to the patient folks in the modding channels for helping me during the creation of this mod (and in one occasion, rubberducking).

A HUGE thank you to the amazing chu ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato]mushymato[/url]) for once again indulging my Old Man Yelling At Clouds.png act and adding all the really cool MMAP stuff that makes the gameplay and special effects of this map possible.
